sloka: स अमात्यो मंत्रि सहितः स भृत्यः पूजितः तदा ।युक्तः परम हर्षेण वसिष्ठम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-५३-७॥
transliteration: sa amātyo maṁtri sahitaḥ sa bhṛtyaḥ pūjitaḥ tadā ।yuktaḥ parama harṣeṇa vasiṣṭham idam abravīt ॥1-53-7॥

translations.english: Having received the hospitality along with his counsellors, ministers and attendants, Viswamitra, filled with great delight, said to Vasishta":
